title: Close synchrony: MPA dependency rundown & proposed timeline
text:
Close synchrony: MPA dependency rundown & proposed timeline

['From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Tucker <alex.tucker@crestlinetx.com>, procurement@crestlinetx.com
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Close synchrony: MPA dependency rundown & proposed timeline

Alex / Procurement team —

Thanks for the productive demo last week. To keep momentum and make sure legal/procurement milestones line up with our onboarding window, I put together a short mutual action plan and dependency rundown. Goal: execute MSA + DPA + Order Form such that we can start provisioning in the week of Nov 23 (target go-live week Nov 30).

High-level dependencies (owners & proposed due dates):
- MSA sign (Legal owners): target 2026-11-17 — we will deliver clean MSA + explanation of redlines.
- DPA review (Legal + Security): target 2026-11-18 — includes data residency appendix if required.
- Order Form / SOW (Procurement): target 2026-11-16 — final pricing and billing contact confirmed.
- SOC2 & security evidence (Security): deliver index + access plan by 2026-11-12.
- PO / Billing authorization (Finance): expected by 2026-11-20 to enable first invoice.

Proposed MAP steps (short):
1) We finalize and upload the MSA redline (attached) — Redwood legal to publish by EOD Nov 12.
2) Crestline legal flags any high-priority redlines by Nov 14.
3) Legal alignment call (if needed) Nov 15.
4) Signatures in DocuSign by Nov 20.

Action items for you: please confirm the billing contact and whether Crestline requires a vendor-risk intake form beyond the SOC2 index we shared. If you want a parallel review path (legal + procurement separate tracks), say so and we’ll split the MAP.

Attachments: MPA_draft_v3.pdf (PDF, 54KB)
Attachment: security-evidence-index.csv (CSV, 12KB)

Thanks — happy to sync 15 minutes today if helpful.

—
Hannah Schmitt
Director, GTM Operations | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0127

Subject: Re: Close synchrony: MPA dependency rundown & proposed timeline

On Tue, Nov 10, 2026 at 9:14 AM Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Alex / Procurement team —
> 
> Thanks for the productive demo last week. To keep momentum and make sure legal/procurement milestones line up with our onboarding window, I put together a short mutual action plan and dependency rundown. Goal: execute MSA + DPA + Order Form such that we can start provisioning in the week of Nov 23 (target go-live week Nov 30).
> 
> High-level dependencies (owners & proposed due dates):
> - MSA sign (Legal owners): target 2026-11-17 — we will deliver clean MSA + explanation of redlines.
> - DPA review (Legal + Security): target 2026-11-18 — includes data residency appendix if required.

Thanks Hannah — appreciate the clarity. A few constraints from our side: procurement has a monthly contract board that meets Nov 19, so to hit your signature goal we need final pricing and a billing lead by Nov 15 at the latest. Otherwise the earliest internal approval pushes to Dec 3.

Two asks from procurement/legal here:
- Can you confirm payment terms (Net 30 vs Net 45) and whether Redwood can accept a PO instead of immediate DocuSign signature?
- We need a short vendor-risk intake (3 pages) and confirmation of whether Redwood stores PHI/PII in plain text; the SOC2 index helps but the intake is required by our vendor team.

I’ll loop in our legal contact (legal@crestlinetx.com) and procurement@crestlinetx.com — they’ll triage the redlines. If you can provide a redline summary call slot on Nov 15 (30 minutes) that would help.

—
Alex Tucker
Senior Procurement Manager | Crestline Therapeutics
alex.tucker@crestlinetx.com
', 'From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Tucker <alex.tucker@crestlinetx.com>, procurement@crestlinetx.com, legal@crestlinetx.com
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 14:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Close synchrony: MPA dependency rundown & proposed timeline

Alex / Crestline legal —

Thanks for the quick read. Quick legal note and proposal for sequencing to avoid repeated redlines: we will issue a redlined MSA (attached) and a short cover note that calls out three high-priority items we expect Crestline to review: indemnity cap language, data residency appendix, and audit notice timing.

From Redwood legal perspective: if Crestline confirms billing cadence (Net 30 vs Net 45) and whether a PO triggers our billing flow, we can commit to producing a second-pass clean MSA for signature by COB Nov 17. If procurement needs Board sign-off (Nov 19) we should aim for DocuSign by Nov 18 to leave a one-day buffer for signatures.

Attachment: MSA_redline_karthik_20261112.docx (Word, 46KB)

I can be on the Nov 15 30-minute slot to walk the three redlines. Otherwise, if Crestline prefers an asynchronous path, please flag the three redlines in a single annotated email and we’ll respond the same day.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Legal Operations | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
', "From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Tucker <alex.tucker@crestlinetx.com>, procurement@crestlinetx.com
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: Updated MAP + signing window — action required by Nov 20

Team — quick update after the legal redline and procurement constraints:

1) Adjusted timeline: we will publish the final MSA for signature on Nov 17 (Redwood) and request Crestline signature by EOD Nov 20. That aligns with your internal board on Nov 19 and leaves Friday Nov 20 as the final signing buffer.
2) Billing terms: we can accept a PO and will honor Net 30 by default. If you require Net 45, that will need commercial approval (Jordan is copied).
3) Security intake: attached index above satisfies the vendor intake for most items; if your vendor team needs a custom intake, please send the form and we will fill it within 24 hours.

DocuSign link (will go live Nov 17): https://docusign.net/Signing/?s=abc123def456
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345/CST-2026-1147

Please confirm: billing contact + PO routing, and whether legal wants the Nov 15 sync (we still have the 30-minute slot). If we don't get signatures by EOD Nov 20, onboarding/resourcing will be pushed until Dec 7.

Thanks all — pushing to keep the provisioning window tight.

—
Hannah Schmitt
Director, GTM Operations | Redwood Inference
"]
